activity_summary: After Fair Em you wrote the mercer's fifty shillings on the tables, under the line that has been there since January: Edith eight shillings, owing, Lady Day. The gown stands against the Queen's twenty pounds, which are not had. You did not mark it paid. You did not write a coffer total, and you did not write the stock's eleven shillings as if they were yours.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the line and did not pay it.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named on the line as the man who brought the figure. He was not in the room.

entities.name: Edith Kettlewood
entities.context: Her eight shillings stayed where January had put them. She was not in the room.
